CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2661 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84. Bus nonce: 80c1a566049576d36f91b53bee4ce88f. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84` or `Fix review: blocked 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 80c1a566049576d36f91b53bee4ce88f`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2661 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2661-80c1a566`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2661, a roster batch (branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr2), head 6156d54c96eddb07dc40ec2ce02f96e899986c84. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

Verify:
(1) Three-dot diff `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD`: only the roster and the delivery row. Any other file blocks the PR.
(2) Each of the 5 group changes (jq over both rosters) matches its commit: set-stage done for R10-SCORES (#2647 merged), R10-FLOW-TOOLKIT-MEASURE (#2645 merged) and R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS-EMITTERS (#2652 merged); append-carry to R10-FLY-SUITE-ENV-FLAKES (the carry #2632's body cites); and the R10-LEARNER-DEFAULT re-cite to coordinator.py lines that exist at origin/main and say what the brief claims. A stage marked done whose PR has not merged on main blocks the PR.
(3) Null control: nothing main wrote to the roster since the merge base is lost. 169 groups before and after, and no group removed.
(4) `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` on the roster reports 0 errors. Record the scoped-gate MODE line. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. The merge-tree against origin/main is clean. VERSION is untouched. Commits carry no footers.
